scope: Declared finite prescription; published regions/phases unverified.

reference_section_certificate.scope: Arb at the declared float x; exact feasible convex segments and global support inequalities of the saved finite model; no dense-region or continuum claim

geometry_scope: Rounded polygon and section diagnostics; original audited support halfplanes are authoritative. UV is a subset of same-setting IR.
comparison_scope: Inner/outer sections quantify unresolved boundary changes; feasible hull alone does not prove the full projected region.
